title: The Humanity of Christ
definition: The humanity of Christ means that Jesus Christ became truly human while remaining fully God.
summary: Jesus entered real human life, experienced weakness, temptation, hunger, suffering, grief, and death, yet without sin.
christFocus: Christ became human to represent us, sympathize with us, obey for us, suffer for us, and redeem us.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Jesus entered real human life, experienced weakness, temptation, hunger, suffering, grief, and death, yet without sin.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, trust Him more deeply, and follow Christ with clarity instead of confusion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
